evals.prompt: Create a v0.9 A2UI JSON array for a reservation confirmation form with party size, date/time, and Confirm/Cancel buttons. Use the Basic Catalog.
evals.expected_output: A valid v0.9 A2UI message array with createSurface, updateComponents, updateDataModel, one root component, bound form fields, and event actions for confirm and cancel.

evals.prompt: Convert this v0.8 A2UI profile card JSONL to v0.9 and explain the important changes.
evals.expected_output: The answer converts surfaceUpdate to updateComponents, beginRendering to createSurface plus root convention, component wrappers to flat component strings, literal wrappers to raw literals, and dataModelUpdate typed contents to updateDataModel values.

evals.prompt: Review this A2UI v0.9 payload and identify why it will not render: [{"version":"v0.9","updateComponents":{"surfaceId":"x","components":[{"id":"root","component":{"Text":{"text":"Hi"}}}]}}]
evals.expected_output: The review catches that createSurface is missing for a new surface and that v0.9 component must be a string, not a v0.8 wrapper object.

evals.prompt: Wrap a v0.9 A2UI createSurface message in an A2A DataPart for the A2UI extension.
evals.expected_output: A DataPart with kind data, metadata.mimeType application/json+a2ui, and data as an array containing the v0.9 createSurface message.
